claims.claim: The bill requires extensive reporting on disaster-loan funding but does not itself appropriate additional funds for the program.
claims.sourceSpan: To improve accountability in the disaster loan program of the Small
claims.note: Absence-based: bill text contains no appropriation of funds; every operative provision is reporting/oversight (Secs. 4-9). "no funds are authorized to be appropriated for official travel" is a restriction, not an appropriation.

notes: Source = Engrossed in House (EH), 10476 chars, matches cache stage "Passed House". No referencedSources. All figures (10%, 24h, 180/90/30 days, Oct 1 2015, July 31 2023, paras 16/17/18, 88/89 Fed. Reg., 2023/2024) verified verbatim. No direction inversions, fabricated entities, or wrong figures. Minor open items: "more frequent" reports (cadence stays monthly), "tends to draw bipartisan support" (class-8 framing), and "dropping the earlier authority to limit new loan obligations" (prior-version claim, not in Engrossed source). Sec. 4 strike of "during the applicable period for a major disaster" is only implicitly captured via summary.
